turns.instruction: Model the continuous beam with spans 3 m, 5 m and 7 m from left to right, and sections B1/B2/B1 respectively. The narrative says that the third-span downward load is 8 kN/m, while the attached load table lists 8, 10 and 12 kN/m from left to right. Request Uz at the third-span midpoint x=11.5 m and Rz at the support x=8 m. Resolve the conflicting load records before reporting numerical results.

Use the table: the downward uniform loads from left to right are 8, 10 and 12 kN/m on spans 3, 5 and 7 m respectively. Analyze and report signed Uz at x=11.5 m and support Rz at x=8 m, with location, direction, units, D case and turn 2. Preserve the span order and B1/B2/B1 section assignment.
